items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: He has the band. I'm playing piano with that band when I'm home too

ctx.x: Yeah. He has the band. I'm playing piano with that band when I'm home too, because his piano player had left just about a year ago. I see. So I play in two bands. But he don't play often because, as I say, he's married. And then the guys in his band, they are a lot older than the guys in my band. They started out way before me. They are more involved in other things.

Yeah, well, the Swedish women I've heard about. Yeah, yeah. It's a great American mythology. But no, seriously, what style do you characterize your band as? Do you have any particular influences? Yeah.
